identity.one_line: A dual-two-handed demonic tank that converts avoidance into armor and magic resistance, uses Carve and retaliation for threat, and leeches or heals through aggression. Its defining cooldowns include Tyrannical Resolve and group mitigation through Infernal Whipcrack. Recent players describe extremely high durability, though that does not prove comparative balance.
